Subject: Whistic profile — claim transfer & provenance clarification

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for taking a look at ClearWave's Whistic profile with us this week. Quick follow-up from our intake: their account currently lists several "claims" (SOC 2, encryption KMS practices, and SSO proof) that ClearWave wants to move under our customer-backed evidence bundle. To make that clean for audit we need: a) confirmation of the provenance for each claim (who uploaded/verified), and b) a suggested owner in Redwood who will accept the claim transfer so we can update the profile metadata.

I've attached a short CSV that maps the claim IDs we see to the evidence artifacts (clearwave_whistic_claim_sheet.xlsx). Could you confirm whether Redwood prefers to accept ownership for the SOC 2 evidence and the KMS attestation? If so, can you also confirm whether Redwood will preserve the original upload timestamps and the signer metadata or if Vendr should preserve that provenance in the claim notes?

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if useful.

Best,
Sam Peters
Vendor Success — Vendr

Attachments: clearwave_whistic_claim_sheet.xlsx

Sam —

Thanks for the sheet, looks clear. Short answers up front: Redwood can accept ownership of the SOC 2 evidence and the KMS attestation, but we need the original upload hashes and signer emails preserved in the Whistic claim notes for provenance. Our on-call security intake (cc'd: Irene) will do a cursory validation before we accept any transfer.

Ben and Irene — can one of you handle validation of the artifacts (quick checksum and signer check) once Vendr signals the transfer? If we accept, we want the claim to show: original uploader, original timestamp, and a "redwood-accepted-on" timestamp.

Sam — if Vendr can initiate the transfer with a temporary read-only preflight (or share presigned copies), that would speed it up. The DocuSign attestation link would also be helpful for audit records if ClearWave has one.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Platform Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Note: please include any internal reference IDs in the transfer so we can tie to our Jira SEC ticket.

Thanks Vanessa — I'll take point on the artifact validation.

- Claim ID 7b9a: metadata missing original uploader email (we see a system account). Need Vendr to provide the verification record.
- Claim ID d0f3: KMS attestation references a key rotation procedure doc hosted in ClearWave's private GDrive; we need a presigned snapshot or a signed PDF for the record.
- Claim ID c2e1: SOC 2 report looks complete but signer block shows "Authorized Representative" without name — DocuSign link would resolve.

Irene — once Vendr provides the presigned artifact + uploader metadata I'll verify checksums and add our acceptance hash. ETA: 24-48 hours after receipt.
